facts.after: An archived list returns only the authenticated creator's archived memos. Direct reads hide an archived memo from other users.
facts.before: The list and direct-get handlers applied visibility rules without these new archive-specific creator checks.
conditions: An anonymous archived list returns an empty response.
A direct archived read by an anonymous user or a different creator returns not found.
The new archive-specific check contains no administrator exception.
The normal-state list retains its existing visibility behavior.
facts.mechanism: The list handler restricts its creator filter. The direct-get handler checks archive state before its ordinary visibility checks.
